bullets: Families and communities in Nigeria grieving mass killings, kidnappings of a pastor's wife and toddler by Boko Haram, violent incitement against Christians, and clergy abductions — with perpetrators rarely brought to justice.
At least 60 Orthodox Christians massacred in two targeted attacks in Ethiopia, leaving families bereaved and survivors living in fear.
Nine Christians killed and forty wounded in the deadliest attack on Jordan's Christian community in modern history, with families and a nation in mourning.
Coptic Christians in Egypt held incommunicado or imprisoned for peaceful online religious expression, with families denied access and charges stemming from statements of faith.
Christian families in India physically attacked, evicted from their homes, and threatened with death for refusing to renounce their faith, with little legal protection or police response.
A Christian man in Pakistan facing a court-upheld death sentence under blasphemy laws, with no relief granted despite appeals.
House church leaders, imprisoned pastors, and a surveillance-monitored human rights lawyer in China enduring years of detention, family separation, and restricted rights — according to ChinaAid.
A convert pastor in Afghanistan tortured and held under house arrest by Taliban authorities, with family members also subjected to violence.
A priest missing in cartel-controlled territory in Mexico, his safety and whereabouts unknown.
A priest murdered inside his home in Lebanon, with grieving congregants and a community left without answers.
Two Montagnard Christians in Vietnam imprisoned on national security charges for practicing and sharing their faith.
A young Cuban asylum seeker facing deportation to a country where his family has already experienced state repression for their faith.
Two house church leaders in criminal detention in China following raids by dozens of armed officers targeting Christians gathered for worship, according to ChinaAid.
Christian healthcare workers in the United Kingdom navigating professional and legal pressures over conscience-based convictions.
An Indonesian congregation of thirty believers awaiting completion of their first legal place of worship after twelve years of bureaucratic struggle.
Two evangelists in Uganda killed for sharing the gospel, with grieving families and communities seeking healing after justice was delivered in court.
Sudanese civilians — including hundreds killed and many more displaced — amid relentless drone strikes destroying power stations, hospitals, fuel supplies, and markets across multiple states
Up to two million civilians in the emptied ruins of a major Darfur city facing famine, destroyed infrastructure, and no prospect of return after a year of siege
Displaced families sheltering in an internally displaced persons camp in Ethiopia's Amhara region, struck by a drone strike that killed and wounded dozens including pregnant women and a child
Roughly 50,000 civilians — many women and children — who fled intercommunal violence in southern Ethiopia and now shelter without adequate support across the border in Kenya
Somali soldiers and civilians caught between ongoing government offensives and al-Shabaab militants across multiple regions, including extortion and forced taxation of vulnerable communities
Christian worshippers in southern Jordan — seven killed and dozens wounded — struck by gunmen during a funeral gathering
Civilians in eastern DRC endangered by a widening rebel coalition taking control of territory and threatening further displacement and violence

More than 3.5 million Nigerians — including over one million Christians — displaced by militant violence across the Middle Belt, with families, communities, and a captive woman and her daughter facing execution and enslavement threats
Survivors and bereaved families in northeastern and central Nigeria after coordinated militant attacks left dozens killed, communities burned, and thousands displaced across multiple states
Civilians and security forces in northeastern Nigeria as over 200 armed militants advance on a military position, placing surrounding communities under threat of rocket fire and roadside bombs
Civilians in northeastern Mali killed in camp attacks and along the border with Mauritania, with bodies discovered days after strikes and survivors evacuated with few resources
Civilians in northern Niger caught between disputed drone strikes that killed two people and an incoming foreign military deployment near volatile border regions
Nearly six million Haitians facing severe hunger and gang violence, including four foreign personnel held captive by armed groups with aid access severely restricted
Residents of a Russian-occupied Ukrainian city — roughly 2,000 cut off for months — as a fragile localized ceasefire allows the first aid deliveries and road demining
Communities across France recovering from widespread riots, looting, and racially motivated violence that left residents killed, wounded, and businesses destroyed
South Korean soldiers and civilians along a militarized border as North Korea launches a series of ballistic missile tests toward international waters
Nearly 5,000 Palestinians in the West Bank displaced by raids, demolitions, and a citywide lockdown following deadly violence at a checkpoint
Residents of Colombia's border region wounded by bomb attacks near a major international crossing amid escalating armed group activity
Civilians in Sinaloa, Mexico, caught between ongoing cartel violence and military operations resulting in deadly confrontations
Muslim and minority-background residents of a Paris suburb targeted in a racially motivated shooting that killed one person and wounded several others including a child
Kashmiri civilians caught between militant attacks that have killed tourists and security personnel and an intensifying security crackdown that has restricted political life
Tens of thousands of families across India displaced and homes damaged after Cyclone Arnab made landfall with destructive winds and widespread flooding.
Hundreds of flood evacuees in Malaysia sheltering in relief centres as rising waters continue to displace families from their homes.
Families in Haiti and the Dominican Republic facing displacement, missing loved ones, and destroyed homes after flooding and deadly landslides.
Families in Syria mourning the deaths of children and adults, with others still missing after heavy rains and flooding across multiple regions.
River communities in Russia facing critically low water levels on the Ob River disrupting navigation and threatening reliable water supply.
Residents across Syria, Indonesia, Papua New Guinea, Chile, and the United States in earthquake-affected areas, including those facing uncertainty after seismic activity near their communities.
Small number of residents in the United States displaced from uninhabitable homes after severe rain-driven flooding damaged an apartment building.
